summary: Join our expert-led training course on Risk Appetite Frameworks and Credit Risk Management. Gain practical knowledge to manage risks and advance your career.
lede: Risk appetite frameworks and credit risk management connect credit exposures with portfolio limits and lending decisions. For professionals working with credit exposure, portfolio control or risk governance, the course covers mapping PD, LGD and EAD, setting tolerance bands, and monitoring concentration and early-warning indicators. Exercises also address stress testing and preparing escalation and appetite reports for committees and boards.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who work directly with credit exposure, portfolio control, and risk governance and need practical tools they can use immediately.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of credit processes, basic financial statements, and general risk terminology. Familiarity with loan underwriting, portfolio monitoring, or risk reporting is helpful, and no coding is required for completion. Advanced concepts such as stress testing, IFRS 9 staging, and capital linkage are taught at an operational level rather than a technical engineering level. You should bring a laptop for spreadsheet-based exercises and be ready to work with sample portfolio data, limit templates, and board-style reporting formats.
